subject: Coordinating Palo Alto exec workshop — staged arrival windows & AV runbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@paloaltoenergy.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Palo Alto c-suite workshop — proposed arrival windows & AV needs

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for confirming the week of April 19 for the executive workshop in Palo Alto. To keep things tidy on our side and make travel smoother for your team, we put together two asks up front:

1) Staged arrival windows so we can stagger check-ins and briefings (avoid lobby congestion).
2) Simple AV/run-of-show checklist so our AV lead can pre-stage equipment and confirm internet/VPN lanes.

Proposed arrival windows (local times):
- Team A (C-suite & exec sponsors): 08:30–09:00 arrival; prep in boardroom A 09:00–09:30
- Team B (product leadership): 09:15–09:45 arrival; breakout setup by 10:00
- Observers & extended attendees: 09:45–10:15 arrival

High-level AV asks:
- Two breakout rooms with HDMI + DisplayPort adapters and USB-C dongles
- 1x wireless lapel mic + 1x handheld for Q&A
- 1 dedicated wired ethernet for live demo host (we'll also provide a failover cellular hotspot)
- Conference Zoom link with co-host permissions for Redwood leads

Attached: short AV runbook and a CSV with the proposed arrival windows so you can share with onsite facilities and travel admins.

Can you confirm: a) the rooms above map to your facility (boardroom A / breakout 2), and b) headcount for Team A (expected 6–8)?

We’ll follow up with a stamped run-of-show next week once we lock flights and arrival times.

Thanks —

Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priом.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable

Attachments: PAE_Workshop_AV_Runbook.pdf, PAE_Staged_Arrival_Windows.csv

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@paloaltoenergy.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Palo Alto c-suite workshop — proposed arrival windows & AV needs

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear proposal — this format is perfect. A couple quick items from our side:

- We can confirm Boardroom A and Breakout 2; facilities will set them aside for the full day.
- Team A headcount is 7 confirmed (CEO + CFO + COO + 4 VPs).
- Please note we will have two external observers (analyst firm) who need guest badges.
- Dietary notes for the VIP table: 2 vegetarian, 1 pescatarian, no allergies otherwise.

One ask: our IT lead Evan Morris (cc’d in a follow-up) needs the Zoom co-host email for the meeting before April 12 so they can run an internal firewall test.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-minute sync tomorrow if you need to walk the runbook.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Corporate Strategy | Palo Alto Energy
samira.khan@paloaltoenergy.com | +1 650-555-0973

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@paloaltoenergy.com>, Evan Morris <evan.morris@paloaltoenergy.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Palo Alto c-suite workshop — staged arrival windows & AV runbook (run-of-show draft)

Thanks Samira — great, we’ll proceed with Boardroom A / Breakout 2 and the headcount noted. Evan — looping you in for the firewall test item.

Attached is a draft run-of-show (one page) and an annotated venue floorplan with AV drop locations. Key operational notes:

- Staged check-in plan: we’ll staff two badge stations outside Boardroom A at 08:00 to support the 08:30 arrivals. Facilities confirmed express badge printing.
- Onsite AV lead (Alex from Redwood) will arrive 07:45 to verify projector/calibration and wired ethernet to demo machine.
- Demo host will use our hardened laptop 10.11.0.42 (wired); we’ll provide a cellular hotspot (T-Mobile) as a backup.
- VPN tunnel: we expect your IT to open port 443 for the demo host and whitelist our OAuth client id; please confirm by Apr 12.
- Travel/staging: we created a simple CSV with individual arrival windows so travel coordinators can book flights into SFO/LAX with cushion windows — see PAE_Staged_Arrival_Windows.csv.

Next actions:
1) Evan to confirm Zoom co-host email and firewall test window by Apr 12.
2) Samira to confirm VIP dietary list final by Apr 5.
3) Priyom/Monica to finalize run-of-show and ship final PDFs to facilities on Apr 9.

If everyone is aligned I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the final logistics and attach the runbook.

Thanks —

Priya Natarajan
Customer Engagement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: PAE_Workshop_AV_Runbook.pdf, Venue_Floorplan_annotation.png

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-03-18T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Palo Alto c-suite workshop — staged arrival windows & AV needs

Confirmed on our side — AV lead Alex will pack spare adapters (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C), two lapels + handheld, and the cellular hotspot. I’ve added an internal checklist to the shared drive and attached the packing list.

Monica Patel
Senior Program Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
